newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman stock index boosted by bank shares.
newsitem.headline: Oman stock index boosted by bank shares.

text.p: Shares on Oman's stock exchange ended the week to Wednesday higher in active trade focused on banking sector shares, a market report said.
The Muscat Securities Market said the index rose sharply, gaining 10.45 points to 280.64 points from 270.19 points a week earlier.
Of the 67 shares traded in the week, 37 rose, 15 fell and 15 were unchanged.
The report put the value of the week's trading at 25.6 million rials ($67.9 million) up from last week's 18.6 million rials.

Among major gainers in the week were Omani International Comapany for Development and Investment, which closed at 4,960 rials from a previous 4,030 rials, National Bank of Oman which ended at 6,820 rials from 6,400 a week earlier, and al-Ahlia Portfolio which closed at 8,200 rials from 7,850.
